summaries.1: Definitions of ADMT, covered ADMT, consequential decision, covered domain, developer, deployer, materially influence, meaningful human review, and related terms (C.R.S. 6-1-1701).
summaries.2: Developer documentation and material-update notices to deployers, plus deployer three-year recordkeeping (C.R.S. 6-1-1702–1703), generally from 1 January 2027.
summaries.3: Point-of-interaction notice, optional public posting, 30-day post-adverse-outcome disclosures, Attorney General rulemaking, FERPA and ECOA interaction, accessibility (C.R.S. 6-1-1704).
summaries.4: Consumer rights to correct inaccurate personal data used in a covered ADMT decision and to request meaningful human review and reconsideration (C.R.S. 6-1-1705).
summaries.5: Attorney General exclusive enforcement as a deceptive trade practice, 60-day cure until 2030, no new private right of action, and relative-fault allocation between developers and deployers with void indemnities (C.R.S. 6-1-1706–1707).
summaries.6: Insurance, HIPAA covered-entity, FDA device, and GLBA interaction rules; restatement that the part creates no new private right of action (C.R.S. 6-1-1708–1709).
summaries.7: Conforming CCPA-style deceptive-trade listing, Division of Insurance rule authority, FY 2026–27 appropriation, 1 January 2027 applicability, and the safety clause (SB 26-189 §§ 2–6).
